response.overview: Boozelbub tells the story of three friends (Robbie, Scotty, and Jeff) who finally get a night to kick it together. The one thing these buds lack? Some suds to help soak up their night. So, out of other options, they re-hatch an old plan: crash a frat party in the hopes of bumming some of their booze for free. On their search, they find a house that just might be the rager they're craving. Only one problem: there's no one to be found. As they explore, they realize they may have crashed the wrong party.
response.title: Boozelbub
